rules.description: When the ESP32-S3 internal USB PHY is used, reserve GPIO19 for USB D- and GPIO20 for USB D+ and prevent unrelated assignments from claiming either pin.

condition.missing_data_policy: UNKNOWN if role or PHY applicability is unknown; BLOCKED when internal USB is known but reservation or assignment records are incomplete.

expected_result.PASS: Internal USB uses evidenced GPIO19 D- and GPIO20 D+ reservations with no unrelated owner.
expected_result.FAIL: A known data pin differs from 19/20 or either pin has a conflicting known assignment.
expected_result.UNKNOWN: USB role or PHY applicability is unknown.
expected_result.BLOCKED: Internal USB is applicable but pin or reservation evidence is incomplete or conflicting.
expected_result.NOT_RUN: The evaluator was not invoked or internal USB is not applicable.

exceptions.condition: A reviewed external-PHY design is selected and its alternate pin mapping is fully evidenced.
exceptions.effect: Internal 19/20 mapping is not applicable; the external-PHY mapping requires a separate rule set.

rules.description: For an evidenced ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N8 module profile, GPIO45 must not be driven high or pulled high during the boot and strapping window.

condition.missing_data_policy: UNKNOWN when the module profile is unknown; BLOCKED when N8 is known but GPIO45 boot behavior is not evidenced.

expected_result.PASS: The N8 GPIO45 record is known and contains no boot-high drive or high bias.
expected_result.FAIL: A known GPIO45 boot drive or external bias pulls the pin high in the strapping window.
expected_result.UNKNOWN: The module variant or applicability is unknown.
expected_result.BLOCKED: N8 applies but the GPIO45 boot-state record or decisive evidence is missing.
expected_result.NOT_RUN: The evaluator was not invoked or the evidenced module profile is outside this initial rule's scope.

rules.description: GPIO3 must have an evidenced, deterministic boot and strapping state; it must not be left high-impedance or without a defined external bias where the selected policy depends on it.

condition.missing_data_policy: UNKNOWN when ESP32-S3 applicability is unknown; BLOCKED when GPIO3 is applicable but the boot drive, external bias, or strap policy is missing.

expected_result.PASS: GPIO3 has a known, deterministic boot-state record and is not high-impedance or floating.
expected_result.FAIL: GPIO3 is known to be high-impedance, uncontrolled, floating, or without the required bias.
expected_result.UNKNOWN: The target or GPIO3 applicability is unknown.
expected_result.BLOCKED: GPIO3 applies but its boot-state or strap-policy evidence is incomplete.
expected_result.NOT_RUN: The evaluator was not invoked or the target is outside rule scope.

exceptions.condition: A different deterministic strap network and its consequences are explicitly reviewed and evidenced.
exceptions.effect: The reviewed fixed state may replace the nominal policy; high-impedance remains disallowed.

rules.description: Detect concurrent ownership of the ESP32-S3 internal USB PHY by USB Host/OTG and USB-Serial/JTAG.

condition.missing_data_policy: UNKNOWN when role or PHY applicability is unknown; BLOCKED when internal Host/OTG is known but concurrency policy is unresolved.

expected_result.PASS: Internal Host/OTG and USB-Serial/JTAG are explicitly non-concurrent.
expected_result.FAIL: Both consumers are explicitly requested concurrently on the internal PHY.
expected_result.UNKNOWN: USB role or PHY applicability is unknown.
expected_result.BLOCKED: Internal Host/OTG applies but the concurrency or debug policy is unresolved.
expected_result.NOT_RUN: The evaluator was not invoked or this internal-PHY ownership check is not applicable.

exceptions.condition: A reviewed external USB PHY and its complete GPIO/resource budget are selected.
exceptions.effect: Internal-PHY ownership conflict does not apply; external-PHY rules and evidence are required.

rules.description: When internal USB Host/OTG removes USB-Serial/JTAG as a concurrent recovery path, preserve an evidenced UART0 recovery and log path on reserved GPIO43/GPIO44.

condition.missing_data_policy: UNKNOWN when USB applicability is unknown; BLOCKED when internal Host/OTG is known but the recovery policy, pins, or reservations are incomplete.

expected_result.PASS: UART0 is an explicit recovery transport and GPIO43/44 are correctly and exclusively reserved.
expected_result.FAIL: A known configuration omits UART0 recovery, uses different known pins, or conflicts on GPIO43/44.
expected_result.UNKNOWN: USB role or PHY applicability is unknown.
expected_result.BLOCKED: Internal Host/OTG applies but recovery-path data or evidence is incomplete.
expected_result.NOT_RUN: The evaluator was not invoked or the internal Host/OTG recovery rule is not applicable.

exceptions.condition: A separately reviewed and evidenced production/recovery path replaces UART0.
exceptions.effect: Requires a new versioned registry decision; it is not accepted automatically by this rule.

rules.description: Compare required independent TX streams with evidenced native UART capacity plus only validated, known alternative serializer capacity; research-only mechanisms do not count toward PASS.

condition.missing_data_policy: BLOCKED when independent demand, native inventory, controller reservations, or claimed alternative capacity is unresolved. RMT and software-UART entries marked RESEARCH_ONLY are excluded.

expected_result.PASS: Verified independent serializer capacity is greater than or equal to the evidenced demand.
expected_result.FAIL: All decisive capacities are known and verified capacity is below the known independent-stream demand.
expected_result.BLOCKED: The capacity comparison is applicable but demand, reservations, or claimed capacity is unresolved or only research-level.
expected_result.NOT_RUN: The evaluator was not invoked or the topology is not an independent-stream topology.

exceptions.condition: The customer evidences that TTL and RS-232 outputs are mirrored copies rather than independent streams.
exceptions.effect: Independent-stream demand is recalculated from the accepted topology; no capacity is invented.

rules.description: A present or future-populated TFT connector cannot pass architecture closure until its interface, required signals, and dedicated GPIO demand are known and mutually consistent.

condition.missing_data_policy: UNKNOWN when provisioning itself is unknown; BLOCKED when PRESENT or DNP_FUTURE applies but Q-C11, interface, signal set, or pin demand is unknown.

expected_result.PASS: TFT interface, signal set, dedicated pin count, decision reference, and assignments are all known and consistent.
expected_result.FAIL: Known TFT data contradicts itself or conflicts with the known GPIO allocation.
expected_result.UNKNOWN: Whether a TFT connector is required is unknown.
expected_result.BLOCKED: A TFT is present or planned, but Q-C11, interface, signal set, or pin demand is unresolved.
expected_result.NOT_RUN: The evaluator was not invoked or provisioning is explicitly and evidentially NONE.

exceptions.condition: Provisioning is explicitly NONE with a reviewed decision reference.
exceptions.effect: The rule is not applicable and returns NOT_RUN, not PASS.

rules.description: A candidate PASS is allowed only when every decisive reference resolves to policy-sufficient evidence with acceptable integrity; missing or insufficient evidence is never treated as PASS.

condition.missing_data_policy: BLOCKED when any decisive reference is missing, unresolved, hash-unverified, or policy-insufficient. A missing evidence catalog is a configuration-validation FAIL and the evidence rule is NOT_RUN.

expected_result.PASS: Every decisive reference resolves, integrity is acceptable, evidence class is sufficient for the rule-scoped claim, and derived claims have a traceable parent chain.
expected_result.FAIL: Resolved evidence contradicts the candidate claim or the result attempts to expand PASS beyond RULE_ONLY.
expected_result.UNKNOWN: Evidence applicability cannot be determined even though the catalog is structurally valid.
expected_result.BLOCKED: A decisive reference is missing, unresolved, integrity-unverified, or supported only by insufficient classes.
expected_result.NOT_RUN: No candidate PASS was produced, the evaluator was not invoked, or configuration validation failed before evidence evaluation.
